the interesting thing about Kali's Fang is that it will always do 2 Agg.
Under "Song of serenity" or when you've been Disarmed once *, you can still
put 2 Agg, which is enough to avoid prevention by a flack jacket or a single
sideslip.

(*) i found that, against Disarm decks, a good way to go is to not remove
the disarm from your disarmed vampires. A vampire can only have one disarm
at a time. so you're immune now, and can't be send to torpor again for 2
damage from Lupo =)

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Yes. Any hand strike can be used during an Immortal Grapple, since
hand strikes arenot restricted.

So you could use Undead Strength, Lucky Blow, Scorpion Sting, Burning
Wrath, etc. - anything that qualifies as a hand strike.

* Hand Strike: any non-ranged, non-weapon strike that deals
damage based on the striking minion's hand damage, or any
minion's non-ranged damage-dealing innate strike.
[LSJ 19970224]



Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <8840-3AE...@storefull-144.iap.bryant.webtv.net>,
Trut...@webtv.net writes

>I recall asking this same question like a over a year ago. I remember
>being answered Kali's/Chainsaw were set in their damage(2agg/3reg).

They are, in that something like, say, Bianca's in built +1 hand damage
won't affect them. It would affect a Bastard Sword, because a Bastard
Sword is based on innate hand damage (strength).

However, something like "Undead Strength" which specifies "melee weapon
damage" *will* affect Kali's Fang, because it is a melee weapon.
